mainEntity.name: What plumbing considerations are there for an outdoor kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plumbing for an outdoor kitchen typically involves installing a sink, and potentially a dishwasher or ice maker, requiring water supply and drainage lines. Ensuring proper water pressure and adequate drainage to prevent standing water is critical. A process clarity point is understanding local codes regarding outdoor plumbing, especially for connections to existing systems and waste disposal. Winterization requirements in colder months are also an important consideration for the longevity of the plumbing system.
